entries.reason: The checked-in runtime exposes the TPMS implicit-body contract but reports it as unimplemented.
entries.evidence: A gyroid TPMS probe with explicit scale, tolerance and finite front/back offsets returned PK_ERROR_not_implemented (5000); no body handle or x_t was retained.
entries.recheckWhen: The runtime implements PK_BODY_create_implicit for a supported TPMS definition.

notes: Implicit-body support is retained as an explicit runtime audit, not a fabricated fixture.
